correctness.rationale: Self-consistency with order parameter re^{iψ} requires r>0; after rotation sin(theta_j)=omega_j/q with q=Kr>=3. For x=q²>9, h=sqrt(x−9), l=sqrt(x−1), the only positive cosine-sign-sum families are (2,2),(2,0),(0,2),(−2,2), producing K_A=2x/(h+l), K_B=2x/h, K_C=2x/l, K_D=x(h+l)/4 with labelled sign multiplicities 1,2,2,1. Differentiating these branches yields unique A minimum at x*=(20+2sqrt73)/3, B minimum at x=18, monotone C and D, and endpoint K_0=9/sqrt2. At x=9 the outer cosine signs merge into precisely one extra-zero-mode state (not four); B folds at K=12 give two distinct labelled degeneracies. The Hessian H=q diag(c)−K(cc^T+ss^T)/4 has the rotational null mode; restriction to c·v=0 and a rank-one Schur complement gives reduced instability indices, including the exact T_A=x/(hl)−1, T_B=9/(x−9), T_C=1/(x−1), T_D<0. This yields total nondegenerate states 0/2/4/8 across open coupling regions and exceptional counts 1,2,6 at K*,K0,12. Independent direct symmetric Hessian eigenvalue calculations reproduced instability histograms at K=4.5,5,7,13; numeric samples do not establish exact thresholds or exhaust real K.
